g.text: Input and retrieved-output controls: terminal checkpoints
Seen wording, 256 worlds per case. A prediction change alone does not establish correct key/value selection.
All normal/reset score vectors agree exactly by construction (95 < 128); this does not establish memory independence. Zeroing retrieval still permits ordinary within-prefix updates.
